parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

😎
antique[ænti:k]adj.
If something is antique, it is very old and rare, and therefore valuable.
→ My grandmother's antique rocking chair is worth a lot of money.
😎
applicant[æplikənt]n.
An applicant is someone who writes a request to be considered for a job or prize.
→ Lots of applicants came into the store when the job position became available.
😎
artifact[a:rtifækt]n.
An artifact is an old object made by humans that is historically interesting.
→ We studied artifacts from an ancient Chinese settlement.
😎
authentic[ɔ:θentik]adj.
When something is authentic, it is not false or a copy of the original.
→ We ate authentic Italian food on our vacation to Rome.
😎
chronology[krənɑlədʒi]n.
The chronology of a series of past events is when they happened.
→ We learned the chronology of World War II in history class.
😎
diplomat[dipləmæt]n.
A diplomat is a representative of a country who works with another country.
→ The Spanish diplomat discussed trade issues with officials in Peru.
😎
epic[epik]n.
An epic is a long book, poem, or movie about a period of time or a great event.
→ The poet wrote an epic about the great discoveries of the past thousand years.
😎
excerpt[eksə:rpt]n.
An excerpt is a short piece of writing or music taken from a larger piece.
→ I didn't listen to the entire symphony online, but I did play an excerpt.
😎
fossil[fɑsl]n.
A fossil is the hard remains of a prehistoric animal or plant.
→ The expert arranged the fossils to build the skeleton of the dinosaur.
😎
humiliate[hju:milieit]v.
To humiliate someone means to make them feel ashamed and embarrassed.
→ I was humiliated when I tripped and fell down in front of the whole school.
😎
lyric[lirik]adj.
When a poem is considered lyric, it is written in a simple and direct style.
→ I enjoy reading and creating my own lyric poetry.
😎
majesty[mædʒisti]n.
Majesty is supreme greatness or authority.
→ You should address the king and queen as your majesty.
😎
monarch[mɑnərk]n.
The monarch of a country is the king, queen, emperor, or empress.
→ The monarch lived in a beautiful palace with a grand gate.
😎
precede[prisi:d]v.
To precede something means to come before it.
→ The hurricane was preceded by a moment of still wind and clear sky.
😎
punctual[pʌŋktʃuəl]adj.
When someone is punctual, they do something or arrive at the right time.
→ My mother hates being late. She is the most punctual person I know.
😎
recruit[rikru:t]v.
To recruit people means to select them to join or work for an organization.
→ We successfully recruited someone to be the new manager.
😎
refund[ri:fʌnd]n.
A refund is money given back to a person when an item is returned to a store.
→ I asked for a refund because the shoes I bought were too tight.
😎
register[redʒistər]n.
A register is an official list or record of people or things.
→ At a wedding there is register for all of the guests to sign.
😎
renown[rinaun]n.
Renown is the quality of being well known due to having done good things.
→ Michael is a singer of great renown in New Zealand.
😎
tusk[tʌsk]n.
A tusk is a long, curved, pointed tooth of an elephant, boar, or walrus.
→ Sadly, some people hunt elephants and remove their tusks to sell them.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Choose the answer that best fits the question.

questions.content: Which of the following might humiliate someone?
questions.explanation: Làm đổ đồ uống (Spilling a drink) có thể khiến ai đó cảm thấy xấu hổ (humiliate).

questions.content: What might be antique?
questions.explanation: Một chiếc ghế sofa cũ (An old sofa) có thể là đồ cổ (antique).

questions.content: Who is referred to as her majesty?
questions.explanation: Một nữ hoàng (A queen) được gọi là bệ hạ (her majesty).

questions.content: Where might a job applicant go for job?
options: A store with an available position
questions.explanation: Người xin việc (job applicant) có thể đến một cửa hàng đang có vị trí trống.

questions.content: What precedes waking up in the morning?
questions.explanation: Đi ngủ (Going to sleep) xảy ra trước (precedes) việc thức dậy vào buổi sáng.

sections.title: Exercise 4: Choose the word that is similar in meaning to the underlined part.

questions.content: The circus performer held on to the elephant’s <u>long, curved tooth</u>.
questions.explanation: long, curved tooth (răng dài cong) của voi tương đương với ngà (tusk).

questions.content: The salesman assured me that the artwork was <u>not false or an imitation</u>.
questions.explanation: not false or an imitation (không giả mạo) tương đương với đồ thật (authentic).

questions.content: At the end of the year, our club will <u>select a new person to join</u>.
questions.explanation: select a new person to join tương đương với tuyển dụng/kết nạp (recruit).

questions.content: Janet isn’t able to <u>arrive at the right time</u> at all. She’s late to school every day.
questions.explanation: arrive at the right time tương đương với đúng giờ (punctual).

questions.content: It is difficult to follow the <u>series of past events and times</u> of computer programming.
questions.explanation: series of past events and times (chuỗi sự kiện và thời gian quá khứ) tương đương với niên biểu/trình tự thời gian (chronology).

questions.content: DNA can be taken from a part of <u>hard remains from a prehistoric animal</u>.
questions.explanation: hard remains from a prehistoric animal tương đương với hóa thạch (fossil).

questions.content: Please stand and read a(an) <u>short piece of writing taken from a larger piece</u>.
questions.explanation: short piece of writing taken from a larger piece tương đương với đoạn trích (excerpt).

questions.content: I took a class at the university where I wrote <u>simple and direct poetry</u>.
questions.explanation: simple and direct poetry tương đương với thơ trữ tình (lyric).

questions.content: The Iliad is a wonderful <u>long book about great events</u>.
questions.explanation: long book about great events tương đương với sử thi, trường ca (epic).

questions.content: Her mother was a dancer of some <u>quality of being well known for doing good things</u>.
questions.explanation: quality of being well known for doing good things tương đương với danh tiếng (renown).

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
Jen's New Job

The history museum needed to recruit a new tour guide. The director interviewed dozens of applicants before he decided to hire Jen. She was chosen because she was friendly, punctual and had a great attitude.

On her first day, Jen got to work and prepared to give her first tour. She looked at the names on the register. She saw that the Queen of England and a diplomat were visiting the museum. She thought, "It's my very first day, and I have to impress a monarch! I hope I don't humiliate myself in front of a person of such renown!"

Jen was nervous. She took a deep breath and said, "Hello, everyone! I'm going to talk to you about the chronology of ancient Egypt." As she turned around to show the group some artifacts, she bumped into a fossil of an authentic elephant tusk. It fell to the ground and broke into a million pieces! "Oh no!" said Jen in a subtle voice. "I sure hope the rest of the tour goes better than this!"

The rest of the tour did not go any better. She tripped over an antique vase and broke a piece off of it. As she was reading an excerpt from a lyric poem, she sneezed and tore a page of the epic.

After the tour, Jen approached the queen to apologize. She said, "I'm sorry, Your Majesty. I was a terrible tour guide. Let me give you a refund for the money you spent."

The queen laughed. She said, "I don't want my money back, Jen. I loved the tour. You just have to be a little more careful and work hard to become the best at your job. Hard work precedes success."

Jen smiled and thanked the queen. She decided to be extra careful from then on. She was persistent and worked hard. In time, Jen became the best tour guide at the museum.

sections.title: Part A: Mark each statement True or False. Rewrite the false statements to make them true.

questions.content: The museum director interviewed dozens of applicants when he recruited a new tour guide.
questions.explanation: Đúng rồi. Ở đoạn 1 có ghi The director interviewed dozens of applicants before he decided to hire Jen. Giám đốc bảo tàng đã phỏng vấn hàng chục người nộp đơn (applicants) trước khi chọn Jen.

questions.content: Jen did not want to humiliate herself in front of the diplomat and the monarch.
questions.explanation: Đúng nha. Đoạn 2 trích dẫn suy nghĩ của Jen: I hope I don't humiliate myself in front of a person of such renown! Cô ấy rất sợ bị bẽ mặt (humiliate) trước những vị khách nổi tiếng như nữ hoàng và nhà ngoại giao.

questions.content: The queen bumped into the fossil of an authentic elephant tusk.
questions.explanation: Sai nhé. Đoạn 3 có viết As she turned around... she bumped into a fossil of an authentic elephant tusk. Tức là chính Jen mới là người vô tình va vào hóa thạch ngà voi chứ không phải Nữ hoàng.

questions.content: Jen was chosen for the job because she was friendly, punctual, and had a register.
questions.explanation: Sai rồi. Đoạn 1 giải thích She was chosen because she was friendly, punctual and had a great attitude. Jen được chọn vì cô thân thiện, đúng giờ (punctual) và có thái độ tốt, chứ không phải vì có cuốn sổ đăng ký (register).

questions.content: Jen broke artifacts, including an antique vase.
questions.explanation: Đúng nhé. Ở đoạn 4 bài đọc kể lại She tripped over an antique vase and broke a piece off of it. Jen đã vấp ngã và làm vỡ một mảng của chiếc bình cổ (antique vase).

questions.content: What did Jen say she hoped for in a subtle voice?
options: Jen hoped that the rest of the tour would go better.
Jen hoped that she would get a raise.
Jen hoped that the queen would leave.
Jen hoped that she could find the pieces.
questions.explanation: Cuối đoạn 3, Jen lẩm bẩm: "I sure hope the rest of the tour goes better than this!" Cô ấy hy vọng phần còn lại của chuyến tham quan sẽ diễn ra suôn sẻ hơn. Đáp án A là chính xác.

questions.content: What chronology did Jen want to talk about to her tour group?
options: Jen wanted to talk about the chronology of Ancient Egypt.
Jen wanted to talk about the chronology of Rome.
Jen wanted to talk about the chronology of the museum.
Jen wanted to talk about the chronology of dinosaurs.
questions.explanation: Trong đoạn 3 Jen đã nói I'm going to talk to you about the chronology of ancient Egypt. Cô ấy muốn thuyết minh về trình tự thời gian (chronology) của đất nước Ai Cập cổ đại. Chọn đáp án A nhé.

questions.content: What happened as Jen was reading the excerpt from the epic lyric poem?
options: She sneezed and tore a page of the epic.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 4 kể lại As she was reading an excerpt from a lyric poem, she sneezed and tore a page of the epic. Khi đang đọc đoạn trích, Jen hắt xì hơi và vô tình xé rách một trang của cuốn sử thi. Đáp án đúng là A.

questions.content: Why did Jen offer her majesty a refund?
options: Jen thought she was a horrible tour guide.
questions.explanation: Ở đoạn 5, Jen xin lỗi I was a terrible tour guide. Let me give you a refund for the money you spent. Jen đề nghị hoàn lại tiền vì tự thấy mình là một hướng dẫn viên quá tồi tệ. Mình chọn đáp án A.

questions.content: What precedes success, according to the queen?
questions.explanation: Cuối đoạn 6, nữ hoàng đã khuyên Jen: Hard work precedes success. Sự chăm chỉ (hard work) là điều kiện đi trước (precede) thành công. Đáp án A là hoàn toàn chính xác.
